assets.title: Outdoor Root-Zone Water Balance
assets.purpose: Show rainfall, irrigation, interception, runoff, infiltration, drainage, evaporation, transpiration and mulch as one outdoor water-balance system.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents rainfall totals or irrigation runtime from being mistaken for actual root-zone water status.

assets.title: Emitter Placement & Wetting Geometry
assets.purpose: Compare emitter positions and soil/media wetting patterns as plant root volume expands.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows isolated wet pockets, dry outer root zones, runoff and under-covered root volume.

assets.title: Root-Zone Moisture Profile — Surface to Active Depth
assets.purpose: Show why the surface, middle and deeper root zone can have different moisture states after rain or irrigation.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps users avoid diagnosing from a dry or wet surface alone.
measurementFocus: dry/moist/wet/saturated class or calibrated sensor value

assets.title: Underwatering vs Overwatering vs Root Disease
assets.purpose: Compare whole-plant and root-zone evidence for water deficit, persistent saturation/low oxygen and root-disease suspicion.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows overlapping wilt/droop symptoms and the root/environment evidence needed to separate them.

assets.title: Mulch — Moisture & Temperature Effects
assets.purpose: Compare mulched and unmulched soil surfaces for evaporation, temperature buffering, weed suppression and stem-clearance concerns.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows why irrigation frequency can change after mulch and why wet material against the stem can create a different local condition.

assets.title: Water Quality, Salinity & Drainage Diagnostic
assets.purpose: Connect source-water pH/EC context, repeated fertilizer inputs, drainage restriction and salt accumulation to root-zone observations.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish possible salt/root-zone stress from a simple nutrient-deficiency assumption.
